input.note:
Cause: volume/zone topology mismatch. events-broker-0 is pinned via nodeSelector to topology.kubernetes.io/zone=us-east-1b, but its PVC (data-events-broker-0) is already bound to PV pvc-3f9c2e71... whose node affinity is topology.kubernetes.io/zone in [us-east-1a]. The scheduler reports "0/9 nodes are available: 3 node(s) had volume node affinity conflict, 6 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector" — no node satisfies both constraints, so the pod stays Pending. A PV's nodeAffinity restricts which nodes can access it, and pods using the PV will only schedule to nodes selected by that affinity [cite: concepts/storage/persistent-volumes#node-affinity-0]. This happened because the gp3 StorageClass is binding volumes immediately, before the pod's scheduling constraints are known; with Immediate binding the provisioner picked us-east-1a without regard to the pod's zone pin.

Fix (safe because the StatefulSet is brand new with no data):
1. Delete the pod and its PVC so the volume can be re-provisioned in the right zone:
     kubectl -n queues delete pod events-broker-0
     kubectl -n queues delete pvc data-events-broker-0
   The StatefulSet controller will recreate both.
2. To prevent recurrence, use a StorageClass with volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer. That delays binding/provisioning until a pod is scheduled, so the PV is created in a topology consistent with the pod's node selectors, affinity, etc. [cite: concepts/storage/storage-classes#volume-binding-mode-1]. Either switch the StatefulSet's volumeClaimTemplate.storageClassName to an existing WaitForFirstConsumer class, or update the gp3 class (or create a gp3-wffc) with volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer.
3. Optionally also constrain provisioning to us-east-1b via allowedTopologies on the StorageClass, which replaces the old zone/zones parameter [cite: concepts/storage/storage-classes#allowed-topologies-0].

After the PVC is recreated under a WaitForFirstConsumer class, events-broker-0 will schedule onto a us-east-1b node and the new EBS volume will be provisioned in us-east-1b.
